text:
samir: follow-up from the postmortem — we keep seeing rollouts that expand before a safe revert exists. low-friction plan: define a small set of safety levers (rapid-revert API, route caps, manual killflow), owners, and short deadlines.

anya: i'll own the rapid-revert API. goal: endpoint that is idempotent, emits audit_id, and returns a verification link. prototype in 1 week.

lee: i'll take responsibility for route-level caps and enforcement in the gateway. default caps = 5% per route, soft org cap = 12% with approver TTL.

ops-bot: alert: monitoring shows 3 high-exposure flags in last 60 days. dashboard: /dash/rollouts/exposure.

pat: ops asks that any automated revert also attach a minimal verification checklist and a link to sample request traces. i'll write the runbook snippet and own oncall training.

henrietta: we should add a small "canary gating" smoke that runs for first 10 minutes of any rollout and fails fast on signal — i'll build the CI job.

samir: sketch of the revert API:
```
POST /internal/revert
{
  "flag": "search-rank-v4",
  "to": "stable",
  "reason": "auto:err_rate",
  "initiator": "automation"
}
-> {"audit_id":"abc123","verify_url":"https://ops/check/abc123"}
```

anya: acceptance criteria i plan to add to the ticket:
- idempotent: repeated calls return same audit_id and no double flips
- emits audit to kinesis with payload (audit_id, initiator, reason, before/after)
- returns verify_url which runs a small health check suite

lee: policy sketch (json example i'll PR):
```
{"route":"*/rank","cap":0.05,"soft_org_cap":0.12,"approver_ttl_mins":30}
```
Enforcement point: gateway enforces route cap, platform reconciler enforces TTL.

pat: proposed action items:
- A1: rapid-revert API + audit stream (owner: anya) — due: 2024-06-06
- A2: gateway route-cap enforcement + schema (owner: lee) — due: 2024-06-01
- A3: oncall verify snippet + runbook (owner: pat) — due: 2024-05-29
- A4: canary smoke CI job for rollouts (owner: henrietta) — due: 2024-06-10
- A5: weekly high-exposure flag dashboard + alert (owner: samir) — due: 2024-06-14

henrietta: CI job will inject a synthetic error and expect revert within thresholds. need infra to schedule staging run.

anya: dependency note: revert API needs feature-flag toggle lib and kinesis audit topic. i'll create tickets and tag @infra and @observability.

samir: small additional guard: manual killflow UI should require typed confirmation + reason and set a TTL on the override. lee can include an API for approver overrides.

lee: will add soft-override flow: approver authorizes, TTL applied, audit entry created. enforcement will log override in an index for quarterly reviews.

pat: acceptance checklist for A3 (runbook) — include exact metric queries, sample CLI commands, and a checklist for oncall to validate rollback success.

ops-bot: synthetic revert scheduled for 1755560280 in staging — will run revert + verification.

anya: i'll add unit + e2e tests and a small demo that triggers a synthetic metric to validate end-to-end.

henrietta: will add the CI job to the rollout pipeline so it runs automatically for the first 10 minutes of new rollouts.

samir: also adding A6: quarterly rollout-configuration audit (owner: samir) — due: 2024-07-01, to catch flags exceeding exposures over time.

pat: please attach PRs to the postmortem follow-up board so auditors can see closure. i'll track weekly and mark done when verified by ops.

anya: I'll open the tickets now and drop a one-page with acceptance criteria by EOD. tagging @lee @pat @henrietta for follow-up.

lee: noted. will have schema PR by middle of this week.

ops-bot: synthetic revert completed at 1755560280 — smoke passed, verification URL responded OK.

samir: great work, team. we'll review progress at next platform sync. :thumbsup:
